Supports 12 vanilla fence types: Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Bamboo, Crimson, Warped, and Nether Brick. The two fence slots may use different types.

guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:oil_.before: Acquisition and use: an oil-press by-product. Use it on crops with supported growth states to advance their growth.
guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:oil_.after: Oil Residue is an oil-press by-product, with 4 produced per batch. Using it on a supported plant makes 2 consecutive bone-meal attempts, each following that plant's own growth rules.
Currently supports 8 plant types: Canola, Onion, Sweet Potato, Houttuynia, Sichuan Pepper Saplings, Wheat, Carrots, and Potatoes. Other plants cannot currently be fertilized with Oil Residue.
A valid use consumes only 1 Oil Residue in total. Fully grown crops and unsupported targets consume none; Creative mode also consumes none.
Each application on a pepper sapling has a 45% chance to advance growth. A valid use still consumes 1 Oil Residue even if neither attempt makes the sapling grow.

guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:pepp.before: Plant a Sichuan Pepper Sapling on a dirt-like block. At light level 9 or higher it can grow randomly, and Bone Meal can also attempt to advance growth.
guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:pepp.after: Plant a Sichuan Pepper Sapling on a dirt-like block. At light level 9 or higher it can grow randomly. Bone Meal can attempt to advance growth; Oil Residue makes two consecutive attempts.

Naturally grown leaves decay when no nearby pepper log supports them. Decay has a 10% chance to drop a sapling and a 2% chance to drop a stick; fruiting leaves also drop 1 Sichuan Pepper. Player-placed leaves do not decay.
Pepper saplings and leaves can both go into a Composter. Each item has a 30% chance to raise the compost level by one.

guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:oil_.before: 取得与使用：榨油副产物；对具有受支持生长阶段的作物使用可促进生长。
guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:oil_.after: 油渣是榨油副产物，每批可得到 4 个。对支持的植物使用时，会连续尝试 2 次骨粉施肥，每次都遵循该植物自己的生长规则。
目前支持 8 类植物：油菜、洋葱、红薯、折耳根、花椒树苗、小麦、胡萝卜和马铃薯。其他植物目前不能用油渣催生。
一次有效使用合计只消耗 1 个油渣；成熟作物和不受支持的目标不消耗，创造模式也不消耗。
花椒树苗每次施肥有 45% 机会推进生长；即使两次都没有长大，有效使用仍会消耗 1 个油渣。

guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:pepp.before: 花椒树苗种在泥土类方块上；光照达到 9 以上会随机生长，骨粉也可尝试催生。
guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:pepp.after: 花椒树苗种在泥土类方块上；光照达到 9 以上会随机生长，骨粉也可尝试催生；油渣会连续尝试施肥两次。
自然长出的树叶失去附近花椒原木的支撑后会凋落：有 10% 机会掉落树苗、2% 机会掉落木棍；结果的叶子还会掉落 1 份花椒。玩家放置的叶子不会自然凋落。
花椒树苗和树叶都可放入堆肥桶；每份有 30% 机会增加一层堆肥。

guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:oil_.before: 取得與使用：榨油副產物；對具有受支援生長階段的作物使用可促進生長。
guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:oil_.after: 油渣是榨油副產物，每批可得到 4 個。對支援的植物使用時，會連續嘗試 2 次骨粉施肥，每次都遵循該植物自己的生長規則。
目前支援 8 類植物：油菜、洋蔥、番薯、折耳根、花椒樹苗、小麥、胡蘿蔔和馬鈴薯。其他植物目前不能用油渣催生。
一次有效使用合計只消耗 1 個油渣；成熟作物和不受支援的目標不消耗，創造模式也不消耗。
花椒樹苗每次施肥有 45% 機會推進生長；即使兩次都沒有長大，有效使用仍會消耗 1 個油渣。

guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:pepp.before: 花椒樹苗種在泥土類方塊上；光照達到 9 以上會隨機生長，骨粉也可嘗試催生。
guide.kg.body.kaleidoscope_grilling:pepp.after: 花椒樹苗種在泥土類方塊上；光照達到 9 以上會隨機生長，骨粉也可嘗試催生；油渣會連續嘗試施肥兩次。
自然長出的樹葉失去附近花椒原木的支撐後會凋落：有 10% 機會掉落樹苗、2% 機會掉落木棒；結果的葉子還會掉落 1 份花椒。玩家放置的葉子不會自然凋落。
花椒樹苗和樹葉都可放入堆肥桶；每份有 30% 機會增加一層堆肥。
